user.title: Connect your Swiggy account
user.description:
Choose how this integration connects to Swiggy.

**Add-on mode (recommended):** Install the Swiggy MCP Proxy add-on from this repository. It handles OAuth via a simple code-paste flow using `localhost` redirect URIs — no Swiggy whitelist approval needed.

**Direct mode:** Connect directly to Swiggy's MCP servers via OAuth 2.1. May show a whitelist error for new clients.

addon.title: Swiggy MCP Proxy Add-on
addon.description:
Enter the URL where the Swiggy MCP Proxy add-on is running. Make sure you have logged in to Swiggy via the add-on's UI first.

Default: `http://homeassistant.local:9584`

address.title: Delivery address & polling
address.description: Choose which saved Swiggy address to use for order tracking and cart actions.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Swiggy servers or the add-on. Check your network and that the add-on is running.
error.invalid_auth: Authorisation failed or was cancelled. Please try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
